UXUC81 is a specific medical procedure code used in the Danish healthcare system to designate transesophageal echocardiography [^src1]. It plays a critical role in the national quality measurement and standardization of diagnostic practices for patients with [[atrieflimren]] [^src1]. As part of the broader clinical quality indicators managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), this code ensures that diagnostic procedures are accurately tracked, registered, and compared across different regions [^src1].

In the context of clinical quality reporting, UXUC81 is formally grouped within the indicator area for [[ekkokardiografi|Ekkokardiografi]] [^src2]. Specifically, the echocardiography indicator domain encompasses a defined set of procedure codes, including [[uxuc80c|UXUC80C]], [[uxuc80d|UXUC80D]], [[uxuc80e|UXUC80E]], UXUC81, and [[uxuc81c|UXUC81C]] [^src1]. By coding transesophageal echocardiography under UXUC81, healthcare registries can systematically monitor the utilization of this specific imaging technique, which is often crucial for evaluating stroke risk and guiding treatment decisions in atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. The consistent application of this code across annual reports, such as the 2023 and 2024 editions of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database reports, highlights its ongoing importance in national cardiovascular quality assurance [^src1] [^src2].
